title: CI: tracker integrity, lore gates and bun run check on dev
description: Delivers opum-agent OPAG-655 AC5, the repo half: a workflow whose checks can be made required on the gated ref (dev). Jobs: Tracker integrity (quest version derived from the CLAUDE.md managed block; tracker reads cleanly; managed instructions current), docs (lore validate/check/agents --check), check (bun run check). Action SHAs pinned. Runs on the fleet's [self-hosted, Linux, ARM64] label, which must be shown to actually serve this private repo. Making the checks required is a ruleset step for the user, after they report green on dev.

acceptanceCriteria.text: All CI jobs run on a ward-cli pull request on [self-hosted, Linux, ARM64] runners and report green on a clean tree, with runner names recorded
A deliberate violation turns the matching job red with the expected error: a duplicated task identity fails Tracker integrity, and a failing test fails check
Every third-party action is pinned to a full commit SHA verified against its upstream tag

implementationNotes: Clean-tree run 36376584432 on PR #2 (head 5c06384): Check, Docs and Tracker integrity all completed/success. Served by the mbpm2 runner group on ephemeral runners linux-arm64-dccd7-runner-bcz22 (Check), -nqsbv (Docs), -fwvrv (Tracker integrity), queued about 9s. This is the measurement that [self-hosted, Linux, ARM64] serves this private repo; the org and repo runner listings show 0 runners, so the API listing alone would have said otherwise.

Negative controls, run 36376639896 on d2f76a0 (one commit, reverted by f482734): Tracker integrity failed at step 'Tracker reads cleanly' with conflict task_lifecycle_duplicate_identity (WCLI-2 in both tasks/ and completed/), exit 5; Check failed at 'Run bun run check' on '(fail) deliberate CI violation'; Docs stayed green, as it should, since neither violation touches docs. Runners: linux-arm64-dccd7-runner-5jvgc, -7vf44, -hd5dw. Action pins verified with gh api against upstream tags: actions/checkout v6.1.0 = d23441a4, actions/setup-node v6.5.0 = 24997072, oven-sh/setup-bun v2.2.0 = 0c5077e5.
finalSummary: Added .github/workflows/ci.yml: Check (bun run check), Docs (lore validate/check --strict, lore agents --check) and Tracker integrity (Quest version derived from CLAUDE.md; tracker reads cleanly; managed instructions current), on pull requests and pushes to dev and main, all on [self-hosted, Linux, ARM64] with SHA-pinned actions. Verified in PR #2: clean-tree run 36376584432 green on all three jobs, served by the mbpm2 group's ephemeral linux-arm64 runners; violation run 36376639896 turned Tracker integrity red on a duplicated task id (exit 5) and Check red on a failing test, with Docs green. The ruleset making these checks required on dev is the user's step, once they have reported green on dev itself.
